context: Category theory: left/right adjunction via natural Hom-set bijections

formulations.text: For functors L:C to D and R:D to C, L is left adjoint to R when there are bijections between the morphisms L(X) to Y in D and X to R(Y) in C, natural in both X and Y.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Algebra: graded free associative algebra generated by a module

formulations.text: For an R-module M, its tensor algebra is the graded associative R-algebra obtained by taking the direct sum over n at least zero of the n-fold tensor powers of M, with the degree-zero summand R and multiplication by concatenation of tensors.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

formulations.text: An integral domain R is normal when every element of its fraction field that satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in R already belongs to R.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Commutative algebra: normality of all prime localizations

formulations.text: A commutative ring R is normal if each localization R_p at a prime ideal p is an integrally closed domain in its own fraction field.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

display_term: Associated prime ideal of a module
context: Commutative algebra: prime annihilator of an element

formulations.text: For an R-module M, a prime ideal p of R is associated to M if p is the annihilator ideal of some element of M.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Field theory: purely inseparable algebraicity in positive characteristic

formulations.text: For a field F of characteristic p greater than zero, an extension K/F is purely inseparable if, for every alpha in K, some p-power alpha^(p^n) lies in F. The trivial extension is also purely inseparable in any characteristic.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Algebraic geometry: a closed immersion into an open subscheme

formulations.text: A morphism of schemes is a locally closed immersion if it admits a factorization through a closed immersion followed by an open immersion.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.

context: Field theory: extensions generated by roots of X^p-X-a

formulations.text: For a field K of prime characteristic p, an Artin-Schreier extension is obtained by adjoining a solution of t^p - t = a, for a in K; a nontrivial such extension has cyclic Galois group of order p.
formulations.editorial_note: Source-checked mathematical candidate; no independent human verification claimed.
